subject: gk
question: India has engaged actively in the multilateral negotiations in the UNFCCC. What is the full form of UNFCCC?

options.text: United Nations Fellowship of Central Climate Change
United Nations Fellowship Convention on Climate Change
United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change
United Nations Framework of Central Climate Change

solution:
The correct answer is __**United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The full form of UNFCCC is** United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change.**
 
• The UNFCCC entered into force on 21 March 1994.
 
• United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) was the first multilateral legal instrument on Climate Change.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There are now 195 Parties to the UNFCCC. “Momentum for Change: Climate Neutral Now" campaign was initiated by UNFCC.
 
• Executive Secretary, UNFCCC: Patricia Espinosa. 
 
• The UNFCCC secretariat is part of the United Nations and primarily focuses on developing climate change mitigation strategies at the global level.

 
• The objective of UNFCCC is to stabilize atmospheric concentrations of greenhouse gases at a level that will prevent dangerous interference with the climate system.
 
• The UNFCCC is a “Rio Convention”, one of two opened for signature at the “Rio Earth Summit” in 1992 held in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
